study type: Genetic variant identification and functional characterization study / Case series with functional validation
cohort: Three unrelated families with clinically suspected Citrullinemia type I (CTLN1) were included in this study.
finding: Two novel variants (c.649_651del (p.P217del) and c.1048C>T (p.Q350*)) and a hypomorphic non-coding variant (c.-4C>T) were identified in ASS1, with functional studies validating their pathogenicity through changes in protein expression, transcription, and enzyme activity.
